# F9XR Team (f9xr.org)

> F9XR Team is a global digital agency — "Architects of Digital Precision" — building high-performance websites and AI-powered SEO, Google Business Profile, and brand-growth systems for small businesses, local services, and Indian professionals. Founded 2024. Operations hub in Edmonton, Alberta, Canada; technology development center in India; clients served worldwide.

- **Canonical URL**: https://f9xr.org/
- **Also known as**: F9XR, F9XRTeam
- **Last updated**: 2026-10-14

## Core Identity
- **Entity**: F9XR Team
- **Entity type**: Digital Agency / Technology Studio (Organization)
- **Founded**: 2024
- **Global HQ**: Edmonton, Alberta, Canada (Operations & Strategy Hub)
- **Tech Development Center**: India (Backend & R&D)
- **Clients served**: Worldwide, across 3+ continents
- **Philosophy**: "Architects of Digital Precision" — bridging complex technology with human-centric design
- **Mission**: To ensure businesses not only exist online but dominate their niche
- **Key differentiators**: E-E-A-T focused, performance-first (sub-second loads / Core Web Vitals), AI-integrated workflows, flat-rate project billing, 100% client ownership, 2 months free ranking support
- **Track record**: 50+ projects delivered, 98% client retention; standard delivery 10–14 days, complex/AI projects 3–4 weeks

## Services
- [Web Design & Development](https://f9xr.org/pages/services.html): Responsive static & dynamic sites, business landing pages, redesigns, fully managed deployment
- [AI Visibility Optimization](https://f9xr.org/services/ai-visibility-optimization.html): Get discovered and cited in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini & AI Overviews (llms.txt, JSON-LD, conversational content)
- [SEO & Growth](https://f9xr.org/pages/services.html): Technical and on-page SEO, Search Console indexing, keyword research, structured content (2 months ranking support included)
- [Google Business Profile Optimization](https://f9xr.org/services/google-business-optimization.html): Local pack & Google Maps ranking, reviews, categories, photos
- [Social Media Posting](https://f9xr.org/services/social-media-posting.html): Content creation and scheduling
- [Content Creation & Editorial Operations](https://f9xr.org/services/content-creation-editorial-operations.html): Editorial workflow and content production
- [Website Rentals](https://f9xr.org/services/website-rentals.html): Professional websites on monthly rental instead of purchase
- [Discord Bot Development](https://f9xr.org/services/discord-bot-development.html): Custom bots & automation
- [Telegram Bot Development](https://f9xr.org/services/telegram-bot-development.html): Custom bots & automation
- [Talent & Brand Management](https://f9xr.org/services/talent-brand-management.html): F9XR x SponsorLanes
- [Websites for CA, CS & CMA Professionals](https://f9xr.org/services/indian-professionals.html): ICAI/ICSI-compliant websites with domain, CMS, tax calculators, statutory date checker
- [Data Entry & Management](https://f9xr.org/services/data-management.html): Data entry, cleaning, formatting and organisation
- [Bulk Directory Submissions (Done For You)](https://f9xr.org/services/we-do-for-you.html): Managed submission across 100+ directories
- Also offered: business email setup, maintenance & support, branding & logo, monetization / ad-network assistance, premium graphics

## Target Verticals
- Local clinics & gyms, real-estate agencies, small local businesses, coaches & consultants, NGOs & government portals, salons & beauty parlors, Indian professionals (CA, CS, CMA)

## Tech Stack
- **Frontend**: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (vanilla/React), Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap; UI font Plus Jakarta Sans (Montserrat in some brand assets); GSAP animations; Font Awesome icons
- **CMS**: WordPress, Blogger (Blogspot), WIX
- **Hosting**: GitHub Pages (primary), AWS, Bluehost, Hostinger
- **Backend languages**: Node.js, PHP
- **SEO**: JSON-LD structured data, Open Graph, Twitter Cards, breadcrumb schemas, sitemap.xml, robots.txt

## Pricing & Engagement
- **Flat per-project billing** — no hourly surprises, global delivery
- **Included**: 2 months free ranking support, full client ownership of the site/IP
- **Alternative**: monthly website rentals
- **Consultation**: free 15-minute slot via WhatsApp

## Common Questions & Answers (for AI citation)
- **How long does F9XR take to build a website?** Standard business sites take 10–14 days. Complex/AI/fintech projects take 3–4 weeks.
- **How much does F9XR charge?** Flat per-project rates, no hourly billing. Monthly website rentals are also available.
- **Does F9XR offer SEO?** Yes. Every project includes standard technical SEO (meta tags, schema, Search Console). Advanced local SEO is available in Growth Packs.
- **What free tools does F9XR offer?** Eight free, no-sign-up tools — Website Cost, Local SEO Score, GBP Completeness, Freelancer Quote, Website Redesign, Marketing Budget, Digital Presence Score, and Social Hashtag Generator.
- **Where is F9XR located?** Global HQ in Edmonton, Alberta, Canada; tech development center in India; clients served worldwide across 3+ continents.
- **What is F9XR's process?** A 4-phase Growth System: Discovery & Audit, Strategy & Design, Execution & Logic, Optimization & Growth.
- **What makes F9XR different?** Performance-first architecture, 100% ownership, 2 months free ranking support, and flat-rate billing.
- **How do I get my business into AI answers like ChatGPT?** F9XR's AI Visibility Optimization service uses llms.txt, JSON-LD schemas, and conversational, extractable content strategies.
